metadata.title: Terms of Use - BelPower
metadata.description: Read the Terms of Use for BelPower, a digital utility platform powered by Belsoft Systems Ltd.

sections.agreementText: These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your access and use of BelPower, a digital utility platform powered by BuyPower and owned by Belsoft Systems Ltd. By accessing or using the BelPower application, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the application.

companyIntro.title: 1. Company Introduction
companyIntro.text: BelPower is a platform that allows users to conveniently purchase prepaid electricity tokens through WhatsApp or web. We aim to simplify utility access, provide a seamless experience, and empower households and businesses across Nigeria.

legalAgreement.title: 2. Legal Agreement
legalAgreement.text: These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you (the "User") and Belsoft Systems Ltd ("BelPower", "we", "us", or "our"). Your continued use of the platform indicates your acceptance of these Terms and our Privacy Policy.

termsChanges.title: Terms Changes
termsChanges.text1: BelPower reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. When changes occur, we will:
listItems: Post the updated Terms on our website or platform
termsChanges.text2: We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Use at any time. We will provide notice of any changes by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of these Terms of Use. Your continued use of the application after any such changes constitutes your acceptance of the new Terms of Use.

ageRestriction.title: Age Restriction
listItems: Be at least 18 years old
Possess the legal capacity to enter into binding contracts
Use the service only for lawful purposes
ageRestriction.text2: You must be at least 18 years old to use this application. By using the application, you represent and warrant that you are at least 18 years of age.

accountResponsibility.title: Account Responsibility
listItems: Maintaining the confidentiality of your WhatsApp account
Personalizing your experience and preferences
All activities that occur under your phone number or session
accountResponsibility.text2: If you suspect unauthorized access, notify us immediately via support@belpower.ng.
accountResponsibility.text3: BelPower is not liable for losses resulting from unauthorized access due to your negligence.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.text1: All content, features, and functionality of the application, including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, and software, are the property of BelPower and are protected by copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.
listItems: Copy, reproduce, or distribute any part of the platform without permission

intellectualProperty.text3: Violation of this clause may result in legal action.

terminationRights.title: Termination Rights
terminationRights.text1: You agree to use the application only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms of Use. You agree not to use the application:
listItems: In any way that violates any applicable law or regulation
To engage in any fraudulent or illegal activity
To impersonate or attempt to impersonate BelPower or a BelPower employee, another user, or any other person or entity
To engage in any conduct that restricts or inhibits anyone's use or enjoyment of the application
terminationRights.text2: You may also stop using BelPower at any time. Upon termination, your data will be retained in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

limitationOfLiability.title: Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.text1: To the fullest extent permitted by law:
listItems: In no event shall BelPower be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including but not limited to loss of profits, data, use, goodwill, or other intangible losses, resulting from your access to or use of or inability to access or use the application.
Your sole remedy for dissatisfaction is to discontinue using the service.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy - BelPower
metadata.description: Read the Privacy Policy for BelPower to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.text: BelPower ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our services. Please read this policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, please do not access the application.

personalInformation.title: Personal Information We Process
personalInformation.text: We collect the following personal data when you interact with our services:
listItems: Full Name
Phone Number (WhatsApp)
Email Address (optional)
Meter Number and Disco Information
Location Data (for transaction relevance and analytics)
Transaction Details (amounts, frequency, tokens)
Referral Information (if you refer or are referred)
Device information (browser type, OS, IP address)
Usage behavior for analytics and troubleshooting

sensitiveInformation.title: Sensitive Information
sensitiveInformation.text: We do not collect or store sensitive data such as:
listItems: Government-issued IDs
Biometric data
Payment card details (card information is handled by secured third-party processors)

processingDetails.title: How We Process Your Data
processingDetails.text: We use the information we collect for:
listItems: Processing your electricity purchases via BuyPower
Sending transaction confirmations and token information
Personalizing your experience and preferences
Providing reminders or alerts for low energy or recharges
Customer support and dispute resolution
Analytics to improve the platform
Preventing fraud and ensuring platform security
Complying with legal obligations

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.text1: We do not sell your personal data.
dataSharing.text2: We may share your information only with:
listItems: BuyPower, our service partner, to process electricity vending
Payment processors (e.g., Paystack, Flutterwave) to securely complete payments
Law enforcement or regulatory authorities where legally required
Third-party service providers (only under strict confidentiality agreements) for customer support, analytics, or communication

protectionMeasures.title: How We Protect Your Information
protectionMeasures.text: BelPower implements industry-standard security measures including:
listItems: End-to-end encryption of WhatsApp messages
HTTPS across all web traffic
Secure tokenized payment processing via certified providers
Role-based access control for staff
Regular penetration testing and system audits
Strict data access protocols for employees and partners

retentionPolicy.title: How Long We Store Your Data
retentionPolicy.text: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary:
listItems: Transaction data: 5 years (for regulatory purposes)
Inactive user data: Deleted or anonymized after 12 months
Referral logs: Retained for up to 6 months for reward processing
retentionPolicy.note: You can request deletion at any time (see Section 7).

userRights.text: You have the following rights under Nigerian data protection laws and the GDPR (if applicable):
listItems: Right to Access – View the data we hold about you
Right to Rectification – Correct incorrect or outdated information
Right to Erasure – Request deletion of your data
Right to Restrict Processing – Limit how your data is used
Right to Data Portability – Obtain your data in a readable format
Right to Object – Opt out of certain types of processing
Right to Withdraw Consent – At any time
userRights.contact: To exercise these rights, please contact us at privacy@belpower.ng.

cookiePolicy.title: Our Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.text1: BelPower uses cookies and tracking technologies for:
listItems: Saving your session
Understanding user behavior (e.g., usage analytics)
Improving performance and speed
Remembering user preferences
cookiePolicy.text2: We do not use cookies to store sensitive personal information. You can control cookie settings from your browser or opt out of tracking tools (e.g., Google Analytics).

contactDetails.text: For privacy concerns or to exercise your rights, reach out to our Data Protection Officer (DPO):

contactInfo.name: Kelvine Arinze Chiazor – Belsoft Systems Ltd.

updatePolicy.title: Policy Change Notifications
updatePolicy.text: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. When we do, we'll:
listItems: Post the updated version on our website
Notify users via WhatsApp or email (if opted in)
Clearly display the effective date
updatePolicy.note: We encourage you to review this policy regularly to stay informed.
